q2: Do I get updates if I buy the Lifetime plan?
a2: Absolutely. The Lifetime plan includes all future updates and feature enhancements for the indicators you purchase, with no recurring fees.
q3: Can I use the indicators on multiple computers?
a3: Your license is tied to your NinjaTrader Machine ID. You can transfer it to a new machine if needed, but it can only be active on one machine at a time.
